windows.description: Conservative normal-fight state: magic defence is +60 when Yama's target uses Magic; slash defence is +80. This state represents approximately two-thirds of the boss's 2,500 HP. Glyphs, movement, flares, transitions and incoming damage are not simulated.
windows.label: Phases 1–2

windows.description: Explicit duo/off-tank state: magic defence is -30 only while Yama's current target is not using Magic. Do not use it for a solo mage. Same boss HP allocation as the conservative P1–2 window; choose one P1–2 state.
windows.label: Off-tank

windows.description: Normal final phase: increased defence bonuses, +81 magic defence and seven-tick auto-attacks. Represents approximately one-third of 2,500 boss HP. Special attacks, perfect-dodge speed-ups, flare healing and prayer piercing are not simulated.
windows.label: Final phase

windows.description: Judge of Yama guarantees maximum hits with alternating Magic and melee. Magic attacks first; reactive prayers then require the other style. Use the paired cycle estimate for both intermissions rather than treating one style as an entire kill.
windows.label: Judge

windows.description: Judge Magic attacks: guaranteed maximum hit while its reactive prayers allow Magic. The normal fight has two 400-HP intermissions, each starting with Magic then alternating melee. The paired attack-cycle estimate combines both complete gear sets; travel, dodge delay and environmental damage are excluded.
windows.label: Judge · Magic

windows.description: Judge melee attacks: guaranteed maximum hit while its reactive prayers allow melee. Alternate after a Magic hit. The paired attack-cycle estimate combines both complete sets across two 400-HP intermissions; movement and environmental damage are excluded.
windows.label: Judge · Melee

windows.description: Contract modifiers, inverted prayer scaling and altered phase thresholds are not modelled. Do not use the normal-fight damage model.
windows.label: Contract

windows.description: One pair of full-health Void Flares (140 HP each) is a declared gear-comparison probe, not a prediction of how many pairs spawn. Magic guarantees a maximum hit; demonbane vulnerability is 200%. Regeneration, projectile travel, flare healing and movement are excluded. Standard ranged max-hit behaviour is not enabled until its weapon effects are supported.
windows.label: Void flares

windows.description: A full-health normal Void Flare has 140 base HP and 200% demonbane vulnerability. Magic guarantees its maximum hit. Regeneration, the explosion and healing Yama are excluded; contracts and ranged weapon effects are not borrowed from this window.
windows.label: Void Flare
